description: This is a front-end HTML page for a database viewer application, providing UI elements and JavaScript logic to browse databases, tables, and view data with dynamic loading and formatting.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resetting current selection.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles display of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders data into an HTML table within the container.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for a table cell based on data type and content length.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses long content or object data within a cell.
